hypothesis: Previous fixed-neighbor regional residuals and independent queries did not pass gates. Test whether content-dependent exchange among all nonself regions captures spatially disconnected but related lesions. Compare uniform nonlocal exchange to isolate the content-routing effect and relative position to isolate spatial information.
architecture: From GELU(original128dimregionprojection), LayerNorm then rank16/32 value GELU. Content branch uses separate query/key scaled dot products, or uniform nonself attention. Compute attention@values-values, then zero-initialized linear readout to128dim and0.1scale. Add residual to original pre-GELU projection. Optional25relative displacement biases on3x3grid. Shared M5 parameters, initial outputs and RNG unchanged; no extra task loss.
training: Original M5 inputs, image sampling, patient/class weights, full coarse+diagnosis+fine-contrastive loss, hyperparameters and original patient fit/stop/outer plans. Each arm3formal+3foldx3seed. Single-image early stopping and ensemble scoring.
selection: Require original patient CV Macro-F1>0.8090823139275858 and validation Macro-F1>=0.8893107959516184. Freeze before fresh patient confirmation against M5 and fixed Gaussian. No automatic external scoring.
verification: Independent double NumPy/SciPy formula; numerical query/key/value/position derivatives, singleton/constant/allmasked limits and permutation equivariance; exact initial common parameters/train/eval/RNG identity and actual loss gradients passed. Every trained head CPU-recovered with actual relation formula reconstructed, attention entropy/distance and branch-off diagnostics retained.
external_test_policy: Only2091development rows accessed by fit/stop/outer. All external feature rows explicitly NaN; no external result or raw image access.
